JSON 无效，请在独立资产窗口的源码页修复。: Invalid JSON. Fix it in the asset window's Source tab.
选择装置以编辑参数。: Select a rig to edit its parameters.
正在使用框架 Lua 加载器校验…: Validating with the framework Lua loader…
将替换当前文档草稿。可通过撤销恢复编辑内容。: Replace the current draft. Undo can restore your edits.
场景预览与资产编辑，各有专属空间。: Dedicated spaces for scene preview and asset editing.
选择 CameraFramework 或其所在的 Lua 目录: Select CameraFramework or its parent Lua folder
磁盘文件已变化，草稿已保留。: The disk file changed. Your draft has been preserved.
从内容浏览器打开资产或文本文件。: Open an asset or text file from Content Browser.
必须且只能挂载一个管线，决定处理阶段及执行顺序。: Exactly one pipeline is required. It defines the processing stages and their order.
最多挂载一个遮挡资产；空数组关闭遮挡处理。: At most one occlusion asset. An empty list disables occlusion.
按数组顺序求值，多个效果的输出贡献相加；整体权重在各效果资产内设置。空数组不贡献: Evaluate in array order and add the output contributions. Each effect defines its own weight. An empty list contributes nothing.
未传业务 ID 时使用第一槽；传入 ID 时匹配对应目标。退出使用自身第一槽。候: Without a business ID, use the first slot. With an ID, select the matching target. Exit uses its own first slot. These are candidates, not a playback sequence. Keep at least one slot.
每个通道选取最靠前的启用配置；未启用的通道可由后续资产补充，不叠加同一通道的配置: For each channel, use the first enabled configuration. Later assets can supply other channels; configurations are not added together. An empty list mounts nothing.
保存会更新当前共享曲线，所有引用方将使用保存后的曲线。: Saving updates this shared curve for all assets that reference it.
更换父类型会重建控制点，可撤销。: Changing the parent type rebuilds control points. This can be undone.
以下资产中的对应引用槽均受修改影响。: The corresponding reference slots in these assets will be affected.
通过图标槽选择和打开引用资产；曲线在引用处只读。: Use icon slots to select and open references. Referenced curves are read-only.
JSON 无效，请在源码页修复。: Invalid JSON. Fix it in the Source tab.
将替换当前草稿，可通过撤销恢复。: Replace this draft. Undo can restore it.
单击选择，双击打开资产编辑器: Click to select; double-click to open the asset editor
按顺序传入参数；支持数字、字符串和布尔值。成员调用会自动传入 self。: Arguments are passed in order. Numbers, strings and booleans are supported. Member calls receive self automatically.
搜索 Assets 中的文件、文件夹…: Search files and folders in Assets…
当前目录没有匹配的内容: No matching content in this folder
右键新建文件夹或资产，或搜索 Assets。: Right-click to create a folder or asset, or search Assets.
个文件 · 双击文件夹进入，双击文件编辑: files · Double-click to enter folders or edit files
创建独立曲线，编辑保存后可在引用处选择。: Create an independent curve. Save it to make it available in reference slots.
从模板复制参数，关联资产继续共享。: Copy parameters from a template. Referenced assets remain shared.
仍被引用的资产不能删除；删除前保留恢复副本。: Referenced assets cannot be deleted. A recovery copy is saved before deletion.
将同步更新资产文件中的引用；业务 Lua 脚本中的路径需另行同步。: Asset references will be updated. Paths in business Lua scripts must be updated separately.
控制点无效，请在右侧或源码中修复。: Invalid control points. Fix them in the parameters or source.
拖动节点或编辑精确参数，保存会更新当前曲线资产。: Drag points or edit exact values. Saving updates this curve asset.
个资产 · 双击文件定位: assets · Double-click a file to locate it
请在源码中编辑此值: Edit this value in the Source tab
对象从 CameraContext 解析，例如 Owner 或 Owner.Ch: Resolve the object from CameraContext, such as Owner or Owner.CharacterMovement. Enter only the method name. The call must return a finite number.
参数名，例如 FOV 或 AnchorLocOffset.X: Parameter name, e.g. FOV or AnchorLocOffset.X
播放时读取当前资产草稿；修改后重新播放生效: Playback reads current drafts. Replay to apply changes.
真实 Lua 管线 · 进入完成后停留 2 秒再退出 · 预览世界提供角色与碰撞: Real Lua pipeline · Hold for 2 seconds after entry, then exit · Preview supplies a character and collisions; verify UE post-processing in the engine
拖动排序；也可用上下方向键调整: Drag to reorder, or use the up and down arrow keys
进入时长，打开资产编辑: Enter duration; open the asset to edit
退出时长，打开资产编辑: Exit duration; open the asset to edit
过渡时长，打开资产编辑: Transition duration; open the asset to edit
逐通道选取最靠前的已启用且活跃的输入；零增量或零权重仍占有通道。Enter、Ex: For each channel, select the first enabled, active input. Zero values or weights still own the channel. Mount at most one Enter and one Exit asset. Each asset owns its phase duration; an unmounted phase completes immediately.
